
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/23173509" title="发布于 2026-10-01 18:55">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【.NET】Logging 库探索（二）：日志过滤</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>人天生有一种能力——信息过滤。只要不是废物都具备这种能力，不需要算法和数据。生物许多行为是本能反应，深深刻进潜意识里。这就是人与机器的本质区别。机器在某些方面一旦没有相关的程序和算法支持，它就是废铁。</p>
<p>日志消息是给人看的，所以，过滤功能必不可少。即应用程序可以根据配置记录或不记录某些日志。</p>
<h2>日志级别</h2>
<p>日志级别由&nbsp;LogLevel 枚举类型定义，<em><strong>从小到大</strong></em>依次为：T D I W E C。看不懂？没事，来一张图。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202609/367389-20260930170732422-2065793840.png" alt="image" width="203" height="208" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">T：Trace</span>——此级别一般用来记录跟踪信息，级别最低，最详细，输出量最多，最影响性能，看得人最烦，江湖外号“五最散人”。此级别推荐在测试阶段用，可以跟踪应用程序的各个细节，以验证程序是否按预期运行。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)">D：Debug</span>——这个表示调试阶段所用，比 Trace 要稍精简一点，一般可用在你在开发时不太确定的地方可以输出调试日志来确认。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">I：Information</span>——从这个级别起，都是默认会输出的日志。Infor 表示常规消息，表示不太重要的日志，感情色彩不浓。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">W：Warning</span>——警告。虽然不会造成程序躺平和数据丢失。但不能疏忽，存在风险。比如，SSL证书过期了。</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1); background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">E：Error</span>——明确应用程序在某处的确发生错误了，应用程序躺平了，不能再运行了。</p>
<p><span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1); color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">C：Critica</span>——意为关键错误，表示很严重的错误。但有时候它也表示一些很敏感的操作，比如管理员帐号被人 Kill 了。</p>
<p>LogLevel 枚举还有一个最大值叫 <strong>None</strong>，这个值比较特殊，它表示忽略日志（不记录），所以它要单独放出来说。</p>
<h2>基于日志级别的过滤</h2>
<p>以日志级别为条件的过滤比较简单粗暴，指定一个级别，大于 / 等于这个级别的日志均会记录。这就是上文在介绍日志级别时，老周强调是从小到大排序的原因。不废话，咱们看个示例就明白。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ILoggerFactory fac = LoggerFactory.Create(lb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    lb.AddConsole();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第一个参数：日志类别
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 第二个参数：日志级别</span>
    <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">lb.AddFilter(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">*</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">, LogLevel.Warning);</span></strong>
});

ILogger logger </span>= fac.CreateLogger(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Demo Log</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogTrace(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Trace 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogDebug(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Debug 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Information 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogWarning(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Warning 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogError(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Error 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogCritical(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Critical 级别</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>这个示例运行之后，只有 Warning、Error、Critical 级别的日志会打印。</p>
<p>咱们按照枚举值的排序，只要看哪些值 &gt;= Warning 就知道了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">enum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel
{
    Trace </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    Debug </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    Information </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Warning </span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Error </span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Critical </span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这个不算</span>
    None = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">6</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>前面调用的 AddFilter 方法就是用来给日志加过滤用的，咱们用到的是以下重载：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">AddFilter(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ILoggingBuilder builder, 
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> category, 
    LogLevel level);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>从定义上看它是扩展方法，category 参数表示日志类别，用于告诉人们这个日志的来源。任意字符串，也可以是某个类名。比如叫 HTTP，当你看到这个类别的日志，你就知道它来自与 HTTP 通信有关的代码。这样如果出现错误，查找范围就缩小了。</p>
<p>上面例子中，老周用了通配符“*"（不是什么神秘符号，就是星号），它表示任何类别的日志都要应用这条过滤规则。当然，通配符也可以这样用：</p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">my.app.data.query.*：匹配 query 后的任何内容，如 my.app.data.query.top、my.app.data.query.baby 等。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">my.app.data.*：匹配以 my.app.data 开头的内容，如 my.app.data.query、my.app.data.delete 等。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">my.app.*：匹配以 my.app 开头的任何内容，如 my.app.nobody、my.app.what_the_fk、my.app.lucky 等。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">*：匹配任何内容，如 abc、abc.def 等。</span></p>
<p>匹配原理和文件名通配符差不多。</p>
<p>level 参数当然就是指定日志级别了，指定后，只要 &gt;= 这个级别的日志都会输出。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[my:logging:LogLevel]
Default</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Information
Database</span>=Error</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2>在配置文件中过滤</h2>
<p>上面的过滤是写死在代码中的，对于不用改来改去的应用是没问题的；对于经常变动的应用，放到配置文件中较好，要改的时候就改配置文件就行了，不用重新编译。</p>
<p>接下来，老周以 ini 文件的配置为例（JSON 文件见多了，ini文件是不是很少见？）演示一下。</p>
<p>在项目中添加一个名为 config.ini 的文本文件。然后输入以下内容：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[my:logging:LogLevel]
Default</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Information
Database</span>=Error</pre>
</div>
<p>有大伙伴可能会疑惑，ini 文件只有“节”和 name=value 组成，如何配置多层次的节点？可以在节标题上使用冒号分隔。即只有最内层的配置使用 name=value 的方式。保存文件后，将文件设置为复制到输出目录，至于是总是复制还有最新版本再复制，自己看着办。</p>
<p>上述配置文件中，指定 Database 类别的日志只输出错误以上的消息，即 Error 和 Critical。Default 相当于“*”，即未指定类别的，默认输出 Information 以上的级别，即 Info、Warning、Err、Critical。</p>
<p>相当于 JSON 文件：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
    “my”: {
        </span>"logging"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
            </span>"<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">LogLevel</span></strong>"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
                  </span>"Default": "Information"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                  </span>"Database": "Error"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>使用 ini 配置文件，需要引用&nbsp;Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.Ini 包，操作方法已超纲，本文不予介绍。</p>
<p>咱们配置 Logging，并加载配置文件的内容。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 准备配置内容</span>
IConfigurationBuilder cfgBuilder = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder();
cfgBuilder.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">AddIniFile(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config.ini</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>;
IConfigurationRoot config </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cfgBuilder.Build();

ILoggerFactory fac </span>= LoggerFactory.Create(lb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    lb.AddConsole();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 从配置文件中加载过滤，注意设置正确的节点</span>
    lb.AddConfiguration(<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">my:logging</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>);
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里要注意一点：在指定让 Logging 加载的配置节点时，不能包含 LogLevel 节点，只指定 my:logging 即可。LogLevel 节点是由 Logging 内部处理的固定命名。源代码在&nbsp;LoggerFilterConfigureOptions 类，它实现了配置接口&nbsp;IConfigureOptions&lt;T&gt;，其中，T 是&nbsp;LoggerFilterOptions 选项类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> LoggerFilterConfigureOptions : IConfigureOptions&lt;LoggerFilterOptions&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">LogLevelKey = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">LogLevel</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">const</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">DefaultCategory = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Default</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IConfiguration _configuration;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LoggerFilterConfigureOptions(IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        _configuration </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> configuration;
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Configure(LoggerFilterOptions options)
    {
        <strong><em><span style="background-color: rgba(0, 204, 255, 1)">LoadDefaultConfigValues(options)</span></em></strong>;
    }
    ……
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>注意到没有？有两个特别的常量，LogLevelKey 的值是 “LogLevel”，DefaultCategory 的值是 “Default”。所以前面老周说，在添加日志的配置文件节点时不要包含 LogLevel 节点，因为这个类会自己找 LogLevel 节点。很明显，该类的核心实现就在&nbsp;LoadDefaultConfigValues 方法中了，咱们看看源码。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LoadDefaultConfigValues(LoggerFilterOptions options)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (_configuration == <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }

    options.CaptureScopes </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _configuration.GetValue(nameof(options.CaptureScopes), options.CaptureScopes);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 枚举当前节点的子级</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (IConfigurationSection configurationSection <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _configuration.GetChildren())
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果子节点就是 LogLevel</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (configurationSection.Key.Equals(LogLevelKey, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 直接加载
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load global category defaults</span>
            LoadRules(options, configurationSection, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果这个子节点不是 LogLevel
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 那么它的下一级就必须是 LogLevel 节点</span>
            IConfigurationSection logLevelSection =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> configurationSection.GetSection(LogLevelKey);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (logLevelSection != <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 那么当前节点必须是 Logging Provider 的名字
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Load logger specific rules</span>
                <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> logger =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> configurationSection.Key;
                LoadRules(options, logLevelSection, logger);
            }
        }
    }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> LoadRules(LoggerFilterOptions options, IConfigurationSection configurationSection, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> logger)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (System.Collections.Generic.KeyValuePair&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>?&gt; section <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> configurationSection.AsEnumerable(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> key 就是 log category，value 就是 log level</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (TryGetSwitch(section.Value, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel level))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? category =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> section.Key;
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (category.Equals(DefaultCategory, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                category </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
            }
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> newRule = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> LoggerFilterRule(logger, category, level, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            options.Rules.Add(newRule);
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>有大伙伴可能看不懂，老周举个例子就你明白了。</p>
<p>回到咱们的示例，前文已设置了日志配置使用&nbsp;my:logging 节点，即，<em><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 128, 1)"><strong>当前节点</strong></span></em>就是 my:logging。请记住它。</p>
<p>现在，它要找 my:logging 的下一级节点，于是找到了 LogLevel。这个节点是符合要求的，它的子级中就是一系列的 name: value 了，其中，name 是日志类别，value 是级别，所以咱们这个例子就是：</p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">类别：*，级别：Information</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 51, 102, 1)">类别：Database，级别：Error</span></strong></p>
<p>如果当前节点不是 LogLevel 呢。那么就要求这个节点的名称必须是 Logging 的 Provider 名称。比如，咱们使用了控制台日志，那么，这个节点就是 Console。即配置文件会变成：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[my:logging:Console:LogLevel]
Default</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Information
Database</span>=Error</pre>
</div>
<p>相当于 JSON 文件：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
   “my”: {
       “logging”: {
            </span>"<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Console</span></strong>"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
                 </span>"<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">LogLevel</span></strong>"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
                       </span>"Default": "Information"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
                       </span>"Database": "Error"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                  }
            }
       }
   }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这样配置后，选项只对控制台日志起作用，不影响其他日志 Provider。假设你同时用了 Debug，EventLogs 等。</p>
<h2>可以自己安排配置节点吗</h2>
<p>由于项目可能会有各种神奇需求，日志的过滤配置可能与内置的规则不同。那能按我们自己定义的来吗？ 那肯定可以的，不管官方内置的配置如何搞怪，其本质就是从配置文件加载内容，对应地产生&nbsp;IConfigurationRoot 根节点，咱们只要按照自定义的逻辑找出需要的节点。</p>
<p>然后，过滤配置有个选项类，叫&nbsp;LoggerFilterOptions。但不能用配置节点直接 Bind 到这个选项类上，因为这个选项类不是只包含属性的简单类。它有一个集合类型的属性叫 Rules，过滤规则实际上是一个&nbsp;LoggerFilterRule 类。但，Logging 库为&nbsp;LoggerFilterOptions 类提供了一个名为&nbsp;AddFilter 的扩展方法，使得其操作与调用 ILoggerBuilder.AddFilter 扩展方法一样。</p>
<p>所以，咱们只要多写几行代码就能达成愿望。先解析出配置节点，再调用 AddFilter 扩展方法进行配置。</p>
<p>理论过于抽象，咱们干点实的。假设在项目中添加了 JSON 配置文件，内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{
  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mylogs</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">filters</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: [
      {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">category</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">level</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Warning</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      },
      {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">category</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xyz</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">level</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Debug</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
      }
    ]
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们看到，日志过滤规则是以 JSON 数组方式配置的，数据组中每个项都有 category 和 level 字段（日志类别和级别）。咱们在代码中实际真正要用到的是数组内的 JSON 对象，即 { "category": ..., "level": ... } 列表。</p>
<p>下面开始处理。先把JSON文件的配置树加载。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>IConfigurationRoot config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
           .AddJsonFile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
           .Build();</span></pre>
</div>
<p>现在，变量 config 就包含整棵配置树了。随后，咱们找节点。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre> ILoggerFactory loggerfac = LoggerFactory.Create(lb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
 {
     lb.AddConsole();            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加控制台日志
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载配置</span>
     IConfigurationRoot config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
                .AddJsonFile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .Build();
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 下面正式处理配置</span>
     lb.Services.AddOptions&lt;LoggerFilterOptions&gt;().Configure(ofo =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
     {
         </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 列出JSON配置中的数组</span>
         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> filterlist = <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mylogs:filters</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">).GetChildren().AsEnumerable().ToArray()</span></strong>;
          ……
     });
 });</span></pre>
</div>
<p>关键点是获取 mylogs:filters 节点下面数组内部的对象列表。GetSection("mylogs:filters") 已经到达了 JSON 数组处，然后咱们只要往后再获取一层，就得到数组中的对象列表了，所以， 要跟着调用 GetChildren 方法。AsEnumerable().ToArray() 是转换为 .NET 中的数组——&nbsp;IConfigurationSection 数组。</p>
<p>接着，来个 foreach 循环就可以读出日志类别和日志级别了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> f <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> filterlist)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? cate = f.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">category</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Value;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? lev = f.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">level</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">).Value;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>.IsNullOrEmpty(cate) &amp;&amp; Enum.TryParse&lt;LogLevel&gt;(lev, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">out</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel loglev))
    {
        <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ofo.AddFilter(cate, loglev)</span></strong>;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>有没有效呢，试试看。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> logger = loggerfac.CreateLogger(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">abc</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogDebug(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Dbg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Info</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogWarning(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Warn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogError(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Err</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

logger </span>= loggerfac.CreateLogger(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">xyz</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogDebug(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Dbg</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogInformation(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Info</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogWarning(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Warn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
logger.LogError(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Err</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);</pre>
</div>
<p>输出结果如下图所示：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202610/367389-20261001181443849-24931804.png" alt="image" width="159" height="224" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;类别 abc 只输出警告和错误；而 xyz 类别则输出了四种日志。这表明：有效的。</p>
<p>你要是嫌不够简洁，还可以把配置项封装一下的。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> FilterConfigEntry
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>? Category { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> LogLevel Level { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span>; } =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> LogLevel.None;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这样一来，直接从 mylogs:filters 节点提取 FilterConfigEntry 数组就完事了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>lb.Services.AddOptions&lt;LoggerFilterOptions&gt;().Configure(ofo =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    FilterConfigEntry[]</span>? items = <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mylogs:filters</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;FilterConfigEntry[]?&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(items <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> or { Length: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }))
    {
        </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> c <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> items)</span></strong>
        {
            ofo.AddFilter(c.Category, c.Level);
        }
    }
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这么一搞，只需一行代码就能把 filters 节点下的数组提取出来了。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>如果你的项目中，配置文件的结构设计好了，将来不会变来变去的话，你甚至可以学官方的做法，直接注册一个 IConfigureOptions 服务。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span> MyLogFilterOptionsConfig : IConfigureOptions&lt;LoggerFilterOptions&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> IConfiguration <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">_m_Config</span>;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyLogFilterOptionsConfig(<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">IConfiguration config</span>)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置树通过构造函数传进来</span>
        <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">_m_Config =</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> config;</span>
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Configure(LoggerFilterOptions options)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 把刚才的配置代码搬到这里</span>
        FilterConfigEntry[]? items = _m_Config.GetSection(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">mylogs:filters</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).Get&lt;FilterConfigEntry[]?&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (items <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> or { Length: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }))
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> c <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> items)
            {
                options.AddFilter(c.Category, c.Level);
            }
        }
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后，把这货注册为单例服务就好了。要单实例，毕竟这东西不需要经常实例化，仅在应用程序启动时初始化就好了。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ILoggerFactory loggerfac = LoggerFactory.Create(lb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    lb.AddConsole();            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加控制台日志
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 加载配置</span>
    IConfigurationRoot config = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ConfigurationBuilder()
               .AddJsonFile(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .Build();

    lb.Services.<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">AddSingleton</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;IConfigureOptions&lt;LoggerFilterOptions&gt;&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> MyLogFilterOptionsConfig(config))</span>;
});</span></pre>
</div>
<p>你瞧，多简洁。</p>
<p>好了，今天就水到这里了，各位，See you La La。</p>
